app.name: Architect Assistant
app.description: Confirm Dynatrace onboarding best practices are in place vs missing.

scopes.name: storage:smartscape:read
scopes.comment: read smartscape nodes (hosts, services, k8s, OneAgent) for best-practice checks; IAM tabs: condition value suggestions

scopes.name: settings:objects:read
scopes.comment: read the OneAgent update policy before changing it; IAM tabs: management zone names for environment:management-zone values

scopes.name: settings:objects:write
scopes.comment: remediation: create ingest enrichment rules, update the OneAgent update policy, the ActiveGate update mode, network zone fallback and the network zones switch

scopes.name: fleet-management:oneagents:write
scopes.comment: remediation: assign host groups via OneAgent remote configuration management

scopes.name: state:user-app-states:read
scopes.comment: read saved primary tag names

scopes.name: state:user-app-states:write
scopes.comment: save primary tag names

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: read metric series dimensions (Dimensional data); ActiveGates: ActiveGate and extension self-monitoring metrics; Extensions: extension self-monitoring status per configuration and host (dt.sfm.extension.status); IAM tabs: condition value suggestions

scopes.name: storage:logs:read
scopes.comment: sampled log coverage (Dimensional data); IAM tabs: condition value suggestions

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: event coverage (Dimensional data); IAM tabs: condition value suggestions

scopes.name: storage:bizevents:read
scopes.comment: business event coverage (Dimensional data); IAM tabs: condition value suggestions

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: read Grail buckets backing logs, events and business events (Dimensional data)

scopes.name: storage:entities:read
scopes.comment: Segments: read classic entities and their management zones; Extensions: names of the hosts and host groups monitoring configurations are scoped to, and process instances for recommendations; IAM tabs: condition value suggestions

scopes.name: storage:system:read
scopes.comment: Segments: list entity types from dt.system.data_objects; ActiveGates: extension framework messages from dt.system.events; Extensions: fastcheck and assignment results (extension framework events); IAM tabs: condition value suggestions

scopes.name: storage:filter-segments:read
scopes.comment: Segments: list segments to match them to management zones

scopes.name: storage:filter-segments:write
scopes.comment: remediation: create and update segments converted from management zones

scopes.name: storage:filter-segments:share
scopes.comment: remediation: create public segments

scopes.name: storage:files:write
scopes.comment: remediation: upload the lookup table each converted segment reads

scopes.name: environment-api:credentials:read
scopes.comment: Fallback: the user-tags, workflows and iam-access functions still read the credential vault entries of earlier versions; Databases: list user-and-password credentials with the Extension authentication scope for a monitoring configuration

scopes.name: environment-api:api-tokens:write
scopes.comment: App credentials: the app-credentials function creates the ReadConfig API token Frontends uses for user tags (stored in the app settings)

scopes.name: environment-api:entities:write
scopes.comment: Frontends / Ownership action: add owner tags (dt.owner:<team>) to frontends and synthetic monitors

scopes.name: environment-api:slo:read
scopes.comment: SLOs: list classic SLOs (metric expression, entity selector, target) and evaluate them for the upgrade comparison

scopes.name: slo:slos:read
scopes.comment: SLOs: list SLOs to match them to classic SLOs by name, and evaluate upgraded SLOs

scopes.name: slo:slos:write
scopes.comment: remediation: create and update SLOs upgraded from classic SLOs

scopes.name: automation:workflows:read
scopes.comment: Problem notifications: list workflows to match them to classic problem notifications by name (creating them goes through the workflows function with a platform token: custom apps cannot request automation:workflows:write)

scopes.name: fleet-management:activegates:read
scopes.comment: ActiveGates: read the last update jobs of an ActiveGate

scopes.name: fleet-management:activegates:write
scopes.comment: ActiveGates remediation: start an update job (update now), and the remote configuration job that sets the ActiveGate group or network zone

scopes.name: fleet-management:activegates:download
scopes.comment: ActiveGates: read the ActiveGate target version (installer version API; no installer is downloaded)

scopes.name: fleet-management:activegate.tokens:read
scopes.comment: ActiveGates: read ActiveGate token expiration dates

scopes.name: fleet-management:activegate.support-archives:read
scopes.comment: ActiveGates logs: list support archives and their collection status

scopes.name: fleet-management:activegate.support-archives:write
scopes.comment: ActiveGates logs: start collecting a support archive

scopes.name: fleet-management:activegate.support-archives:download
scopes.comment: ActiveGates logs: download a collected support archive ZIP

scopes.name: fleet-management:activegate.support-archives:delete
scopes.comment: ActiveGates logs: cancel a running collection or delete an archive

scopes.name: extensions:definitions:read
scopes.comment: Databases: check whether each database extension is active in the environment, and read its monitoring configuration schema; Extensions: list every extension in the environment (installed / not, for recommendations and SNMP); IAM tabs: extension names for extensions:extension-name values

scopes.name: extensions:configurations:read
scopes.comment: Databases: list a database extension's monitoring configurations and their status, to find one that already targets a database; Extensions: read every monitoring configuration (scope, activation context, enabled) to find broken ones and local vs remote

scopes.name: extensions:configurations:write
scopes.comment: Databases remediation: create a monitoring configuration for a database extension

scopes.name: app-engine:apps:run
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: list installed apps and the scopes their manifests request (App Registry), for shared:app-id values

scopes.name: settings:schemas:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: list settings schemas and read a schema definition (schema groups), for settings:schemaId / settings:schemaGroup values

scopes.name: storage:spans:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: record-level field values seen on spans (sampled), for dimensional data suggestions

scopes.name: storage:bucket-definitions:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: list Grail buckets and their tables (dt.system.buckets), for storage:bucket-name / storage:table-name values

scopes.name: iam:users:read
scopes.comment: Permissions Test: find users by name or email (environment IAM API)

scopes.name: iam:groups:read
scopes.comment: Permissions Test: find groups by name (environment IAM API)

scopes.name: fleet-management:network-zones:read
scopes.comment: Network Zones tab: hosts that use a zone as alternative or failover (network zones hostStats)

scopes.name: app-settings:objects:read
scopes.comment: App credentials: the app functions read the app-credentials settings object (secrets come back in plain text only to the app's functions); the UI shows which credentials are set

scopes.name: app-settings:objects:write
scopes.comment: App credentials: admins store the account OAuth client and the platform / API tokens in the app-credentials settings object; also checked (effective permissions) to decide who may change them

scopes.name: iam:service-users:use
scopes.comment: App credentials: list the service users a platform token can be generated for
